cloud_model.description: Cloud model for readings Gemini Nano cannot take (a language it does not read, no Nano on the device).

second_opinion_model.description: Cloud model asked for a second opinion when the device's reading fails a check.

second_opinion.description: Switches cloud second opinions on or off for every copy of the app.
